facts.text: The wrapper's default robot address is 169.254.241.245:31950; OT2_HOST overrides the host
health() sends GET /health and returns the robot server's name, api_version and robot_model without a run
create_run() must be called before movement or aspiration; toggling the lights and homing do not need a run
create_run() stores the run id from the server's data and fills the run command and action endpoints
get_run_info() reads the run list, adopts the current run's id, pipette and labware, and returns the run data
home_robot() posts target robot to the home endpoint
load_pipette() requires a run id, sends the configured PIPETTE name, and stores the returned pipette id
load_labware() requires a run id, accepts a slot in range(1, 12), and stores the returned labware id under the slot name
control_run() accepts play, pause, stop and resume-from-recovery and posts the action to the run actions endpoint
aspirate() requires a run id and a pipette id
aspirate() takes volume in uL and flow rate in uL/s
dispense() requires a run id and a pipette id
dispense() takes volume in uL and flow rate in uL/s
The default pipette name is p300_single_gen2 and the caller may change the instance's PIPETTE

measures.description: Number of runs returned by the robot's run list
measures.name: run_count

safe_state.description: the current run is stopped with the run action stop
